name: whatsapp-utility-templates
desc: Get WhatsApp templates approved as UTILITY by Meta, and keep them there
author: candiani
typing: WhatsApp templates approved as UTILITY, and kept there
Checker calibrated on 16 real verdicts, 16 of 16 reproduced
Skeleton for Meta, sentence for the reader: two layers
Python stdlib only, works as a Claude Code skill
tagline: Write, check, submit and track WhatsApp Cloud API templates that Meta approves as UTILITY.
pitch: **whatsapp-utility-templates** is the difference between a template that opens conversations for months and one that Meta silently moves to MARKETING 25 minutes after approving it: an anchor test, a five part anatomy, a checker that rejects what tends to fall, and a button pair whose click actually lands somewhere.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta or Anthropic. "WhatsApp" is a Meta trademark; "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: Claude Code skill plus scripts for WhatsApp Cloud API message templates in the UTILITY category
what.anchor: a template talks about a request the reader already has; anything that invites them to start something is MARKETING
what.anatomy: name and speaker · anchor line · one wide slot with a protocol-style example · closing question · two quick replies
what.checker: scripts/check.py rejects body, examples and button labels that tend to fall; --corpus replays 16 measured verdicts
what.buttons: one accept, one decline, both answering the skeleton's question; payload by index so the webhook can route the click
what.after: one template per WABA · fail-closed preflight reads the live category before every send
what.install: git clone into ~/.claude/skills · Python 3.8+, stdlib only
